bio: Satisfied customers are the raison d’être of this stylish villa, where you are graciously greeted by Nathalie before taking a seat in the elegant dining room. Veteran chef Kurt Verhaege aims to work with fresh, seasonal produce. He boasts a classical training and his textbook perfect champagne sauce is a model of French culinary technique, as are his main courses and side dishes, which also feature a subtle international slant. Delicious eater-friendly prices....
